name: Daynori Google Drive provider-verification and authorized folder access audit

provider.name: Google Drive API v3 & Google Picker API v2
provider.gateStatus: blocked (fail-closed pending owner Google Cloud OAuth credentials and live interactive consent)

drive.file.folderSelectionBehavior: Selecting a folder in Google Picker authorizes the folder container metadata, but DOES NOT cascade grants to pre-existing unpicked files or new external additions.
authorizedItems: Folder container explicitly selected in Google Picker
Individual files explicitly selected in Google Picker
Files created or uploaded by Daynori into the folder
deniedItems: Pre-existing files inside the selected folder that were not picked
External additions dropped into the folder via drive.google.com or other apps
drive.file.verificationRequirement: Standard Google OAuth App Verification (no CASA assessment required)

drive.readonly.grantModel: Read-only access across entire user Google Drive
drive.readonly.folderSelectionBehavior: Enables automatic discovery and one-way recursive mirroring of all files in chosen folder, but exposes all user Drive contents.
drive.readonly.verificationRequirement: Mandatory Tier 2 Cloud Application Security Assessment (CASA AL2) by authorized lab, annual recertification, Letter of Validation (LOV), and Google OAuth restricted scope review.

drive.grantModel: Full read/write access across entire user Google Drive
drive.folderSelectionBehavior: Enables two-way folder synchronization, move/delete, but requires unrestricted access.
drive.verificationRequirement: Mandatory Tier 2 CASA AL2 assessment, annual penetration testing, Google restricted scope review.

acceptedProductBehavior.uiRepresentation: Familiar indented folder hierarchy rendered via buildAuthorizedDriveTree; unpicked items remain suppressed; copy vs reference status clearly badged.
acceptedProductBehavior.disconnectGuarantees: Tokens wiped, generation incremented, jobs fenced, imported copies retained in Daynori, remote Drive originals never deleted or trashed.
